posts.tagline: Website To PDF Tool that actually works.
posts.description: Most website to PDF tools capture before the page finishes loading, so JavaScript, fonts, or animations end up missing. SaveWebToPDF lets you set a loading wait time so the page renders fully first, choose device view (desktop, tablet, mobile), block ads and trackers for a clean export, and toggle dark mode. Free, no sign up, zero server storage; files exist only in your browser until you download them. Export as PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WEBP.

posts.name: Spend Forecast
posts.tagline: Offline expenses/income budget tracker & forecast generator
posts.description: Built for the privacy-conscious, Spend Forecast is a fully local finance tracker. No cloud syncing, no data selling, and absolutely no monthly subscriptions. Your data never leaves your device. Key Features: Cash Flow Forecast: Visualize your projected balance up to 90 days in advance based on your recurring bills and scheduled income. This cash forecast app lets you know if you can afford a purchase before you make it. Premium Visual Themes: Switch between four custom-engineered interfaces

posts.name: DoughCue · Sourdough Log
posts.tagline: Private offline sourdough starter and bake journal
posts.description: DoughCue keeps sourdough starters, baker’s-percentage recipes, six-phase bake timelines, reminders, loaf outcomes, and factual insights together on your iPhone or iPad. Everything stays on-device, with no account, subscription, ads, analytics, or tracking.

posts.name: FairFlow – pay for minutes dictation app
posts.tagline: Dictation on the iPhone, no subscription, using Whisper
posts.description: Pay-as-you-go AI dictation for Mac and iOS. Speak naturally — FairFlow formats messy voice notes into structured text. No subscription.

posts.name: BEFOREVIBE
posts.tagline: Anyone can build it. Few think it through.
posts.description: BEFOREVIBE turns a fuzzy app idea into a structured PRD — with a logo and screen previews — before you open your AI builder. Free to use. Works with Replit, Lovable, Bolt, v0, and Cursor. Also available as an MCP connector for Claude Code.

posts.name: Noema — Focus & Calm Sound for Deep Work
posts.tagline: AI radio that learns your taste and becomes yours
posts.description: Adaptive AI radio for deep work, sleep, and calm. Tap a mood or ask Siri; fully hands-free, and sound starts in seconds. The more you listen, the more it becomes yours. No account needed. iOS.

posts.name: Pulse Tracker - android music tracker
posts.tagline: Pocket music tracker for Android with synths and samplers
posts.description: Turn your Android phone into a pocket music workstation. Pulse Tracker combines tracker-style sequencing with synths, an 808, sampling, automation, step FX, song arrangement and WAV export. Inspired by the Dirtywave M8, but designed from the ground up for touch. The free version can create complete tracks with no ads, while Pro adds more synths, Drum Sampler, DX7 SYX import and expanded sequencing.

posts.name: Scoret
posts.tagline: Guess the secret number, crush your friends.
posts.description: Welcome to Scoret, a lightning-fast multiplayer guessing duel. 🎮 How it works: Player A locks in a secret number (1-100). Player B tries to guess it. Get real-time temperature feedback (from 🧊 FREEZING to 🔥 SUPER HOT). Guess it fast to earn max points before you run out of rounds! ⚡ The Features: • Zero Friction: Share a 6-digit code, play instantly in-browser. • Solo Mode: No friends around? Challenge the bot. • Neon UI: Real-time feedback, responsive design, and victory confetti.

posts.name: Is Extension Safe?
posts.tagline: Check is extension safe and don't collect your data
posts.description: Chrome extensions ask for one line of permissions in a file you never open, and the store answers with a star rating. is-extension-safe downloads the actual package, strips the obfuscation, reads the source and shows you exactly what data each extension can reach, with the file and line behind every claim. No verdicts, no scare labels. We describe capabilities, print what the analysis couldn't check, and publish corrections. Paste any store link to request an audit.

posts.name: Ad Library Winner Finder
posts.tagline: Filter the noise. Find the winners.
posts.description: I built Ad Library Winner Finder after wasting too much time and money running Meta ads. The Meta Ad Library is powerful, but it's hard to quickly identify which ads are worth studying. This extension adds active-day tracking, performance labels, advanced filters, Shopify detection, AI summaries, HD creative downloads, CSV export, and an Ad Vault all directly inside the Meta Ad Library to make competitor research faster and more organized.

posts.name: twoHelixes
posts.tagline: Make graphs about your data with AI
posts.description: Ask for a chart of any data you have - a spreadsheet, a database, a warehouse - and get one back in seconds, correct and readable.

posts.name: Modern Mentor
posts.tagline: Discover leading influencers based on value not algorithms
posts.description: Modern Mentor helps you discover the world’s top thought leaders based on your interests instead of browsing history. Browse categories and the Top 50, explore rich profiles with bios, books, and live channel analytics, and follow voices that fit your goals. Join the community to rate, curate, and share recommendations so others can find life-changing mentors.

posts.name: Freeman Protocol — Build AI & survive
posts.tagline: A cyber-defense where AI agents protect, gather, & repair
posts.description: Recruit autonomous AI agents, build your defenses, manage your resources, and battle an escalating army of hostile machines in a playable sci-fi war experiment.

posts.name: AI Text to Video Generator
posts.tagline: Paste a script, get a finished faceless video.
posts.description: Faceless Video Generator turns any written script into a fully voiced, subtitled, scene-by-scene video — no camera, no face, no timeline editor. AI splits your script into scenes, generates images, adds neural voiceover, and syncs word-by-word captions.

posts.name: LightningApply
posts.tagline: Job applications at lightning speed
posts.description: AI job application assistant that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from any job posting in seconds. Pass ATS screens and land more interviews. Subscription memberships offer additional AI tooling like interview prep and profile analyzer and optimizer.

posts.name: WexChat Pro
posts.tagline: Independent XChat status, safety, and download guide
posts.description: WexChat Pro is an independent, source-linked guide to XChat. It helps people check what is actually available, find official download paths, understand encryption and privacy caveats, compare XChat with WhatsApp and Signal, and avoid unofficial installers. It is not affiliated with X or xAI.

posts.name: DocuForge AI
posts.tagline: Auto-generate docs, unit tests & diagrams with Code RAG 📄
posts.description: DocuForge AI turns raw code into production-ready READMEs, API specs, security audits, unit tests, & Mermaid flowcharts in seconds. Powered by an in-browser WASM SQLite RAG vector engine for instant codebase Q&A with exact citations.

posts.name: Perfect XI
posts.tagline: Football squad draft simulator
posts.description: Perfect XI is a fully offline, native SwiftUI football draft simulator—built for play anywhere and ready for iOS 27. Spin a club and season, draft one player from that era, build an all-time XI, then see how chemistry, position fit, managers and luck shape a 38-match campaign. It’s free to play with no ads; one lifetime purchase unlocks every premium feature forever. Earn trophies, tackle daily challenges and share seeded rematches. Weekly Game Center leaderboards are coming soon.

posts.name: NXTCue
posts.tagline: AI-powered next track recommendations for DJs
posts.description: NXTCue detects your currently playing track and suggests compatible tracks for your DJ set. Built for Serato, rekordbox, VirtualDJ, djay Pro, and Mixxx.

posts.name: Creator Script Studio
posts.tagline: Write, practice, and present better video scripts
posts.description: Creator Script Studio brings video script preparation into one browser-based workspace. Write, paste, or upload a script, track word count and estimated speaking time, listen with voice playback, save drafts locally, and present confidently with the built-in teleprompter. It is free to use, requires no account, and keeps locally saved drafts on your device.

posts.name: Purr Break
posts.tagline: Pause for a purr break
posts.description: Listen to gentle cat purring sounds for relaxation, focus, and a little pause between everything else.

posts.name: The Ultimate Travel Planner
posts.tagline: The all-in-one trip planner: itinerary, budget & packing
posts.description: The Ultimate Travel Planner is an all-in-one Excel/Google Sheets system: colour-coded itinerary, auto-calculating budget tracker, packing checklist, bucket-list goals, an ADHD-friendly toolkit, and a live dashboard — one file, no extra apps.

posts.name: AI Context Extractor – Copy Any Page
posts.tagline: Copy any webpage into ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
posts.description: AI Context Extractor copies the webpage you're viewing—not just its URL—into AI-ready Markdown with a single shortcut. It works on logged-in sites, SPAs, localhost, internal dashboards, and pages AI crawlers can't access. The extension extracts titles, headings, content, tables of contents, selected text, and metadata, then copies everything directly to your clipboard for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI assistant. Everything runs locally with no accounts, no servers, and no tracking.

posts.name: MapMarked
posts.tagline: Turn any address on earth into sellable map art
posts.description: Most map tools give you a poster file. MapMarked gives you the whole product line in one sub: pick any address on earth, choose from 3,900+ palettes (or build your own), and get the print-ready 300 DPI file, styled room photos for your listings, and the product copy to sell it in about a minute. Free preview of your own street, no account. One map is $6.99; sellers subscribe for volume, a commercial license, and white-label. Built solo on a self-hosted OSM renderer.

posts.name: Buyer Thoughts
posts.tagline: See what other buyers think before you buy on Amazon
posts.description: Buyer Thoughts adds a tiny bar to Amazon product pages showing what other shoppers think — before you buy. Answer three one-click questions: Would you buy this? Worth the price? Does it look trustworthy? No account, no review to write. New products show a disclosed estimate from Amazon's own rating instead of "0 votes." 100% anonymous — no name, email, or order data ever read. Free, works instantly.

posts.name: PickFace: Face Album Maker
posts.tagline: A group photo that sorts itself into a face album
posts.description: PickFace turns one group photo into a shareable face album. Vision scans the photo in tiles, not one pass, catching small or distant faces a single scan misses, then auto-straightens every crop, even upside-down. Choose a yearbook grid, photo with faces, or a simple grid. Detection only, never recognition - no biometric data is ever created. Free for 5 scans a month; one-time unlock removes the cap and the ad, no subscription. On-device, no account, no network calls of its own.
